cat > /workspace/project/include/offline_api.h <<'EOF'
#ifndef OFFLINE_API_H
#define OFFLINE_API_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * Offline replay ABI.  One whole JSON batch is decoded by solver.py into a
 * compact little-endian program per case; the collector replays that program
 * on the CPU and returns one certificate blob per case.  No NIC, switch, GPU
 * or external service participates.
 *
 * Legacy egress callback type kept for the supplied switch substrate.
 */
typedef int (*epic_emit_fn)(void *user, int rank, const uint8_t *frame,
                            size_t length);

typedef struct {
    int32_t primitive;   /* index into epic_primitive_t */
    int32_t mode;        /* 2 = reliability translation, 3 = result ownership */
    int32_t root;        /* 0..3 */
    uint32_t segments;   /* K */
    uint32_t words;      /* D */
    uint32_t capacity;   /* N */
    uint32_t start;      /* 24-bit base PSN */
    uint32_t trace;      /* number of leading emissions to retain */
} epic_case_params_t;

void *epic_case_new(const epic_case_params_t *params);
int epic_case_run(void *context, const uint8_t *program, size_t length);
const uint8_t *epic_case_result(void *context, size_t *length);
void epic_case_free(void *context);

#endif
EOF
cat > /workspace/project/src/replay_api.c <<'EOF'
/*
 * replay_api.c -- offline transport ABI entry points.
 *
 * The collective/transport state machine lives in src/collector.c; frame
 * sealing and parsing stay in src/roce_packet.c.  The supplied live switch
 * (src/star4_switch.c) is retained in the tree for its real four-port
 * behaviour but the finite replay path no longer depends on live I/O.
 */
#include "offline_api.h"
EOF
cat > /workspace/project/Makefile <<'EOF'
CC = gcc
BUILD ?= build
CFLAGS = -std=c11 -O2 -fPIC -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-parameter
SOURCES = src/replay_api.c src/collector.c src/roce_packet.c src/star4_switch.c
HEADERS = include/epic_clean.h include/offline_api.h include/offline_port.h
.PHONY: all clean
all: $(BUILD)/libepic.so
$(BUILD)/libepic.so: $(SOURCES) $(HEADERS)
	mkdir -p $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -Iinclude -shared $(SOURCES) -o $@
clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)
EOF
